common.machineTranslated: Peji iyi yakashandurwa nemuchina uye haisati yaongororwa nemunhu anotaura mutauro uyu.

footer.note: Golden Moments inopa zviitiko zvakareruka zvakagovaniswa pamwe chete zvekufadzwa. Haisi zvokurapa, bvunzo kana kurapwa, uye haifungi, haiyeri kana kupa mapoinzi kumunhu upi noupi. Mibvunzo yehutano itaurirane nachiremba. Kana paine kukasira, shandisa nhamba yekukurumidza yenyika yenyu yekuda rubatsiro.

home.title: Mitambo nezviitiko zvedementia neAlzheimer's | Golden Moments
home.description: Mitambo yemifananidzo inofadza yakasununguka yekutamba paintaneti uye mazano ezviitiko kuvanhu vanogara nedementia kana Alzheimer's nevanovatarisira. Hapana kunyoresa, hapana nguva kana mapoinzi.
home.eyebrow: Yakasununguka · Hapana zvizivisa · Hapana kunyoresa · Hapana nguva kana mapoinzi
home.h1: Mitambo Inofadza nZviitiko zvevanhu vane Dementia
home.lede: Mitambo yemifananidzo iri nyore, mifananidzo yakajairika, nezviitiko zvekufadza pamwe chete—zvinoenderana nekumhanya kwenyu.
facts: Mira nguva ipi neipi; hapana chinokundikana
home.heroApp: Zvakare app yakasununguka yeiPhone, iPad neAndroid, ine mifananidzo yemhuri yenyu
home.gamesLede: Imwe neimwe inodzikama, yakakura uye inokurumidza kutanga. Sarudza imwe, garai pedyo, mugoverane kudzvanya.

steps.title: Sarudza chinhu chakajairika
steps.text: Mifananidzo yetasi rekapu, minda, mhuka nemabhoti emakwenzi. Hapana kuverenga kana mitemo yekudzidza kutanga.

steps.title: Garai pedyo
steps.text: Regai vadzvanye. Taurirai nezvemifananidzo. Mufananidzo usina kufanana unongomirira kudzvanya kwakatevera.

steps.title: Mirai kana zvichinakira
steps.text: Mutambo mumwe unoita chiitiko chakazara. “Zvapera kwazvino” inogara ichioneka pachiratidzo.

home.stageLede: Mimhanzi, mabasa echitsuwa, kurangarira uye nguva dzakanyarara dzekuona nekunzwa, zvakagadziridzwa kune zvinonakira parizvino.

stages.title: Nhanho yekutanga
stages.text: Ramba uchiita zvavanofarira, nezvishandiso zvidiki: mabviro, zviendo, mitambo yemashoko nekuronga pamwe chete.
stages.label: Mazano enhanho yekutanga

stages.title: Nhanho yepakati
stages.text: Mabasa akareruka anozivikanwa akapatsanurwa muzvikamu: kupeta, kuronga, mimhanzi, mitambo yemifananidzo nezvifambiso pfupi.
stages.label: Mazano enhanho yepakati

stages.title: Nhanho yekupedzisira
stages.text: Kunyaradzwa nekubatana nekubata, nzwi nekuona: kugadzirisa maoko, nyimbo dzavanofarira, mifananidzo nekuva pamwe chete.
stages.label: Mazano enhanho yekupedzisira

home.specificHtml: Unotsvaka chinhu chakananga? Edza zviitiko nemitambo yeAlzheimer's, mitambo yakapfava yekurangarira, mibvunzo yakapfava kana mapuzzles.
home.approachTitle: Chiitiko chemumwe nemumwe, kwete bvunzo yekurangarira
home.approachLede: Mitambo mizhinji ye“brain games” yakavakirwa pakumhanya, mapoinzi uye mitevedzo. Kune munhu ane dementia izvi zvinogona kuita sebvunzo. Isu takaita zvakasiyana.

principles.title: Hapana chinokundikana
principles.text: Hapana nguva, mapoinzi, mwero kana kukundikana. Mufananidzo usina kufanana ndokumira kwechinguva, kwete kukanganisa.

principles.title: Mifananidzo inoramba ichioneka
principles.text: Kuziva kupfuura kurangarira. Kubatanidza kunotanga nemifananidzo yakatarisa kumusoro, saka hapana chinofanira kurangarirwa.

principles.title: Mukuru uye ane rukudzo
principles.text: Mashoko akapfava, akajeka uye mifananidzo yechokwadi. Hapana makatuni kana kutaura somwana.

principles.title: Yakavanzika nekuda kwekugadzirwa kwayo
principles.text: Hapana akaunti kana zvizivisa. Mifananidzo yenyu haibudi pachidzanzi chenyu.

guides.title: Kutamba mitambo pamwe chete
guides.text: Kugadzirira, kumhanya uye zvokuita kana mutambo wasisaisiri kufadza.

guides.title: Kana vachiti hakuna pachiitiko
guides.text: Zvikonzero zvakajairika zvekuramba, nenzira dzakapfava dzekuedza zvakare gare gare.

guides.title: Kugadzira tabhureti
guides.text: Mashoko akakura, kushomeka kwekutyora zvinhu uye peji imwe yakareruka yekutanga.

guides.title: Zviitiko zvinodhindwa zvemahara
guides.text: Kutsvaga mashoko makuru, mapeji ekupenda, bingo nemakadhi ekutaura.

home.researchTitle: Hutano hwouropi: tsvagiridzo inoti chokwadi chii
home.researchText: Dementia inogona kudzivirirwa here? Mitambo yeuropi inobatsira here? Kuti kufura, kudya, kurara nekuteerera? Mhinduro dzakajeka dzine sosi, pamwe chete nekuti humbowo hwakasimba sei.
home.appText: App yakasununguka inoshanda isina internet uye inogona kushandisa mifananidzo yemhuri yaunosarudza, yakachengetwa semifananidzo pachidzidziso chako. Dhizaini imwe yakadzikama: matairi mana makuru, pasina nguva, pasina mapoinzi.

faq.q: Mitambo ipi yakanaka kune vanhu vane dementia?
faq.a: Mitambo yakanaka ndiyo yakapfava, yakajairika uye isina kumanikidzwa: mifananidzo mikuru yekuenzanisa, kuronga, majigsaw mapfupi, kupedza mazwi akazivikanwa, kupenda, bingo yemifananidzo nemakadhi ekutaura. Sarudzo yakanaka ndiyo inofadza munhu nhasi. Dzivisai taimi, mapoinzi nechinhu chinoita sekuti ndeyekuyedza.
Hongu. Mitambo yose nemapepa ekudhirowa pa Golden Moments yakasununguka, pasina akaunti, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Mitambo inoshanda mu browser pafoni, tabheti kana komputa.

Kwete. Hapana mutambo wakaratidzwa kudzivirira dementia, uye Golden Moments haizvizivisi kuti inorapa kana kudzivirira chinhu chipi zvacho. Mitambo yedu yakagadzirirwa kufadza uye kugovera nguva pamwechete. Chikamu chedu chehutano hwepfungwa chinotsanangura zvinoratidzwa nekutsvagisisa uye zvisingaratidzwi.

faq.q: Mitambo iyi inokodzera munhu ane Alzheimer's here?
faq.a: Hongu. Alzheimer's ndiyo chikonzero chakajairika che dementia, uye mitambo yakagadzirwa nekuda kwayo: mifananidzo mikuru inoramba ichiratidzwa, sarudzo shomanana, uye hapana chinhu chekuyeuka kana kukanganisa. Kuenzanisa, kuronga nekupedza mazwi akajairika zvinovakira paruzivo rwakachengetwa kwenguva refu, kwete pakudzidza zvinhu zvitsva.

faq.q: Munhu ane dementia yakagwinya here anogona kushandisa zviitwa izvi?
faq.a: Kazhinji anogona, kana paine munhu ari pedyo. Tangai neTsvaga zvakafanana nemifananidzo miviri, Mapaya emifananidzo ane matairi mana, peji rekupenda kana kumira kwekufema kwakanyarara. Itai kuti zvive pfupi, tevererai zvavanoda uye mumise kana vaneta.

Webhusaiti haina akaunti uye haina zvekuzivisa. Tinoshandisa Google Analytics kuti tinzwisise mapeji anoshanyirwa. Mifananidzo yaunosarudza yeMapaya emifananidzo inoratidzwa chete mu browser yako uye haisi kutumirwa kumusoro.

Golden Moments ibhandi diki rinoita zviitwa zvemifananidzo zvakanyarara zvevakuru zvemhuri nevanochengeta, pawebhu uye sechishandiso chakasununguka. Hatisi vachiremba, uye hapana chiri pano chokurapa.

playCta.title: Wakagadzirira mutambo wakanyarara?
playCta.text: Mifananidzo mikuru, pasina taimi, pasina mapoinzi uye pasina chekunyoresa. Tambai pamwechete mu browser yenyu.

appCta.title: Tora mitambo iyi nawe
appCta.text: Iyo app yakasununguka ya Golden Moments yeiPhone, iPad neAndroid: matairi emifananidzo mikuru, mitambo nemifananidzo yemhuri yako, uye mapakeji emifananidzo anoshanda pasina Wi‑Fi. Pasina akaunti, zvekuzivisa, taimi kana mapoinzi.

activities.label: Zviitwa
activities.title: Zviitwa Zvevanhu vane Dementia
activities.seo: Zviitwa Zvevanhu vane Dementia: Mazano Maererano neDanho
activities.description: Mazano ezviitwa kuvanhu vanogara nedementia padanho rese: mimhanzi, kuyeuka zvakare, mabasa emazuva ese, zviitiko zvekunzwa, mabasa emaoko, kunze kwemba uye mapepa ekudhirowa asingabhadharwi.
activities.lede: Chiitwa chinofadza ndechipi zvacho chinounza runyararo, chinangwa kana kubatana kwechinguva. Tangai nezvaakambofarira munhu, uye muzvigadzirise nenhasi.

caregiving.label: Kuchengeta
caregiving.title: Magwaro Ekuchengeta
caregiving.seo: Magwaro Ekuchengeta Dementia: Rubatsiro Rwemazuva Ese
caregiving.description: Magwaro akanaka uye ane tsitsi evanochengeta vane dementia: kutamba pamwechete, kutaurirana, kuramba kwavanoita, kusuwa kwemanheru, matabheti, kusarudza mapoinzi uye kuzvichengeta.
caregiving.lede: Rubatsiro rwakajeka uye rwakananga rwemazuva ese ekuchengeta munhu ane dementia, kusanganisira kuzvichengeta iwe pachako.

brain-health.label: Hutano hwepfungwa
brain-health.title: Hutano Hwepfungwa: Zvinotaurwa neKutsvagisisa
brain-health.seo: Hutano Hwepfungwa neNjodzi ye Dementia: Zvinotaurwa neKutsvagisisa
brain-health.description: Dementia inogona kudzivirirwa here? Magwaro akavimbika ane masosi nezvinokonzera njodzi ye dementia, mitambo yepfungwa, kusadya kwenguva, kudya, kuita kwemuviri, kurara, kunzwa uye zviratidzo zvekutanga.
brain-health.lede: Zvinoratidzwa nezvidzidzo zvikuru zvechokwadi pakuderedza njodzi ye dementia, zvakatsanangurwa zvakajeka, pamwe nezvinhu zvisina kujeka kana zvisingabvumirani. Ruzivo rwakajairika, kwete zvekurapa.

guide.sourcesNote: Tinobatanidza kumasangano nezvidzidzo zvinoenderana nepeji iyi. Imwe neimwe yakaongororwa paakagadziridzwa peji.

healthNotice.title: Ruzivo rwakajairika, kwete zano rekurapa
healthNotice.textHtml: Peji iyi inopfupisa kutsvagisisa kwakabudiswa kuvanhu vemhuri. Haigoni kukuudzai zvakanaka kune munhu mumwe chete. Taurai nachiremba musati washandura kudya, kuita kwemuviri, kurara, mishonga kana zvekuwedzera. Kana paine kusuwa kwakasimba kana mamwe mashanduko akasimba, wanai rubatsiro rwekurapa ipapo ipapo. Verengai chiziviso chedu chehutano.

about.title: Chiitwa Chakagovaniswa, Kwete Bvunzo Yekurangarira
about.description: Nei mitambo yeGolden Moments isina taimi, mapoinzi kana mitsara yekukurumidza, nei mifananidzo ichingoramba ichiratidzwa, uye zvatichasatsanangura nezve dementia.
about.lede: Golden Moments inoita zviitwa zvakanyarara zvemifananidzo zvevakuru, izvo muchengeti nomunhu ane dementia anogona kufarira pamwechete.
about.bodyHtml:
Zvatinotenda

Chinangwa chemutambo chiri panguva yacho pachayo: mukurukuru, kumwiyiwa, kugutsikana kwekuisa mifananidzo miviri pamwe, kana kungogara pedyo nomumwe. Hachisi kuyera munhu, kumusundidzira kuti aite zvakawanda kana kuratidza chimwe chinhu.

Mapurogiramu ekudzidzisa hunyanzvi hwepfungwa anowanzo kuvakwa nekumhanya, mapoinzi, mitsara yekuhwina nemazinga. Kune munhu anorarama nedementia, izvi zvinogona kuita sebvunzo yausingakwanise kupasa. Isu takaita zvakasiyana, uye tinozvisunga pamitemo iyi:

  • Hapana chinhu chekukundikana. Hapana kirokhi, mapoinzi, kauntara yekufamba, mimwe yekuhwina, makanzuru kana kuverenga kwekushaya nguva, pane chero skrini.
  • Kuzivisisa kupfuura kuyeuka. Mifananidzo inoramba yakaonekwa kana zvakasarudzwa. Mibvunzo inokurudzira hurukuro uye haibvunzi mazita kana zviyeuchidzo.
  • Makuru, akajeka uye akatsiga. Mavara akakura nemifananidzo, mavara akajeka, uye mabatani anoramba panzvimbo imwechete.
  • Kuremekedzwa somunhu mukuru. Mifananidzo yehupenyu chaihwo uye mashoko akajeka, anodziya. Hapana makatuni, kurumbidza kwakaita sedoro, kana zvimboni zvemifananidzo.
  • Nzira yekubuda nyore. “Tapedza panguva ino” inoramba yakaonekwa. Kumira pakati pemutambo ibudiro rakanaka.
  • Zvakavanzika sezvakasarudzwa. Hapana akaunzi kana zvipoko. Mifananidzo yaunosarudza inoramba pamudziyo wako.

Zvatisingazvidi

Mitambo yedu yekunakidzwa nekubatana. Haidzidzise, haiyeri, haiongorore, haibatsiri kurapa, kudzikisa, kana kudzivirira dementia kana chirwere cheAlzheimer’s, uye hapana anofanira kuizvisarudza nechinangwa ichocho. Kana tichinyora nezvetsvagurudzo pamapeji edu ehutano hwepfungwa mapeji edu ehutano hwepfungwa, tinotsanangura pachena kuti humbowo hwakasimba sei, uye hatibatanidzi neimwe yemitambo yedu.

Ndiani isu

Golden Moments ibasa diki rakazvimirira. Isu hatisi vanachiremba. Zvinyorwa zvedu zvinobva pamirayiro yakabudiswa nemasangano akadai seNational Institute on Aging neAlzheimer’s Association, uye chinyorwa chega chega chinotaura kwaunobva. Verenga kuti tinonyora sei uye tinoongorora sei mapeji edu.

Tiudzei zvinobatsira

Tinofara kunzwa zvinoshanda kwamuri nezvisingashandi, kunyanya kubva kuvanhu vanorarama nedementia, vanhu vanovatarisira mumhuri, nevashandi vemisangano yemitambo. Tumirai email kuna {email}.

editorial.title: Nzira Yatinonyora uye Yatinoongorora Mapeji Edu
editorial.description: Nzira Golden Moments inotsvaga, inonyora, inotsigira nekugadzirisa mapeji edu emitambo yedementia nehutano hwepfungwa, uye zvatisingazobudisi.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Zvinyorwa zvedu

Mazano edu anovakwa pamirayiro yeruzivo yakabudiswa nemasangano akadai seNational Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance neNHS, uye pamapepanhau ekutsvagurudza akaongororwa nevanyanzvi akadai seCochrane reviews nemaedzo makuru ekurapa. Chinyorwa chega chega chinotaura zvinyorwa zvacho zvinotsamira pazvo. Tinovhura chinyorwa chega chega tisati tachitaura, uye tinotaura chete zvinoti zviri mukati mazvo.

Kunyora kwedu

  • Zvinobatsira kutanga: zvekuita nhasi, mashoko akajeka.
  • Kutaura chokwadi nezvehumbowo: tinoshandisa “zvinobatana nazvo”, “zvinogona” uye “humbowo hunosiyana” kana ichocho chiri chokwadi.
  • Kuremekedza: tinonyora nezvevanhu vanorarama nedementia savanhu vakuru, uye hatishandisi mibvunzo kana mashoko anonyadzisa.
  • Hapana zvakagadzirwa: hapana manhamba, mashoko, vanyanzvi, ongororo, mabvunzo kana zvinotendwa zvakagadzirwa.

Vanoongorora mapeji edu

Mapeji anonyorwa uye anoongororwa neboka reGolden Moments, nerubatsiro rwezvishandiso zveAI rwekutsvaga nekunyora. Peji rega rega rinoongororwa neboka pamusoro pezvinyorwa zvarwo. Mapeji edu haana kuongororwa nachiremba kana mumwe mushandi wehutano, uye hatizvidi kuti aita. Ruzivo urwu rwakajairwa chete, haruna kuva zano rezvehutano.

Zvatisingazobudisi

  • Mashoko ekuti mutambo, chikafu, zvekudya zvinowedzerwa, kufunga kana kugara zvakafanana nguva dzose zvinodzivirira, zvinorapa, zvinodzikisa kana zvinoporesa dementia.
  • Mibvunzo, mabvunzo kana mapoinzi anoratidza kuti munhu ane dementia kana haana.
  • Zano rekutanga, kumisa kana kuchinja mushonga upi zvawo.
  • Zvivakashure kana zvinyorwa zvakavanzwa sezvinyorwa zvezano.

Zvakagadziridzwa uye kugadziridzwa

Peji rega rega rinoratidza zuva rekupedzisira rakagadziridzwa. Kana muwana kukanganisa kana sosi isina zuva, tumirai email kuna {email} uye tichaongorora nekukurumidza.

faq.title: Mibvunzo neMhinduro
faq.description: Mhinduro kumibvunzo yakajairika nezvemitambo nemitambo yedementia: mitambo yekutanga, kurefu sei kutamba, mazano emunguva yakagumisa chirwere, hutano hwepfungwa nekuchengetwa kwemavara.
faq.lede: Mhinduro dzakapfupika, dzakajeka kumibvunzo yavanovatarisira vanobvunza zvakanyanya.

items.q: Mitambo ipi yakanakisa kune munhu ane dementia?
items.a: Mitambo yakanakisa ndiyo inozivikanwa, iri nyore uye isina kumanikidzwa, uye yakakodzera ndiyo inofadza munhu nhasi. Kubatanidza mifananidzo nemifananidzo yakaonekwa, kuronga, majigsaw ari nyore, kupedzisa mashoko akajairika, kupenda nemutambo wemifananidzo webingo zvinoshanda kuvanhu vakawanda. Regai mazinga, mapoinzi uye chinhu chingaita sebvunzo.

items.q: Mitambo iyi inonyanya kuva yemahara here?
items.a: Ehe. Mitambo yose nemapeji ekuprinta zvakasununguka, pasina account, kunyoresa, kuisa pasi kana zvekuzivisa.

items.q: Nei pasina mapoinzi, matanho kana tayimer?
items.a: Kumhanya nemapoinzi zvinoita kuti chiitwa chinofadza chishanduke kuva bvunzo, izvo zvinogona kuunza kunyadziswa kana kusuwa. Tinoisa pfungwa pakufara nekuva pamwe chete nenguva, saka pasina chinhu chekukundikana uye munogona kumira panguva ipi neipi.

Foni ipi neipi, tabuleti kana kombiyuta ine webhurawuza yazvino. Tabuleti yakamiswa patafura inowanzove nzira inonyatsonaka kuti vanhu vaviri vatambe pamwe chete. Laputopu yakabatanidzwa neTV inoshanda zvakanaka kumapoka.

items.q: Tinogona kutamba nemifananidzo yedu yemhuri here?
items.a: Ehe. Mapaire Emifananidzo anoshandura mifananidzo 2 kusvika ku6 yamunosarudza kuita mutambo wekubatanidza. Mifananidzo inogara muwebhurawuza yenyu, haizotumirwi kana kuchengetwa kwandinzwi.

items.q: Chiitwa chinofanira kutora nguva yakareba sei?
items.a: Kazhinji maminitsi 10 kusvika 20 anokwana, uye dzimwe nguva maminitsi 2 chete ndiko kubudirira. Tarisai zviratidzo zvekuneta kana kusuwa, uye mumire panguva yacho yakanaka. Hapana nguva yakarurama.

Remekedzai kuramba kwavo, uye edzai zvakare gare gare kana nenzira imwe. Kuramba kunogona kubva pakuneta, kurwadziwa, kusava nechokwadi kana kungoshaya chido. Verengai bhuku redu nezvekuti muite sei kana vachiti hako.

items.q: Ndezvipi zviitwa zvakakodzera dementia yakasvika kumagumo?
items.a: Kunyaradza nezvakuvaka: kunzwa mimhanzi yavanofarira, kupfeka mafuta pamaoko, kutarira mifananidzo pamwe chete, kubata shashu yakapfava, kugara panze, kana mutambo mudiki wemifananidzo nomumwe munhu pedyo. Bhuku redu rezvakasvika kumagumo rine mimwe mazano mazhinji.

items.q: Kune zviitwa zveboka mumba mekuchengetera vakuru here?
items.a: Ehe. Bingo yemifananidzo ine makadhi ekuprinta uye muparidzi ari pascreen, uye Pedzisa mazwi nemakadhi ekutaurirana zvinoshanda zvakanaka kana zvaverengwa nkuru. Bhuku redu remaboka emumba mekuchengetera rinotsanangura huwandu hwevanhu, kugara nekugadzirisa vanhu vane masimba akasiyana.

items.q: Mitambo inogona kudzivirisa kana kudzikisa dementia here?
items.a: Hapana mutambo wakaratidzwa kudzivirisa dementia, uye mitambo yedu haitaure zvakadaro. Kusimudzira kufunga mukati mevanhu kwakaratidza mabenefiti madiki mutsvakurudzo kune vanhu vane dementia yakabva pashoma kusvika pakati, asi izvozvo zvakasiyana nomutambo unodzivirisa chirwere. Tinopa mitambo yekufara nekubatana.

Hapana chokwadi. Tsvakurudzo inobatanidza zvinhu zvehutano nemararamiro 14 nenjodzi yedementia, zvakadai sekuterera kwenzwi, kumanikidzwa kweropa kwakakwira, kusafamba zvakakwana nekusava nehukama nevamwe. Kugadzirisa izvi kunogona kudzikisa njodzi kune vamwe vanhu, asi vanhu vazhinji vanoita zvose zvakanaka vachiri kurwara dementia. Hapana munhu anofanira kupomerwa.

items.q: Kusadya nguva nenguva (intermittent fasting) kwakanaka here hutano hwomusoro?
items.a: Humbowo hwevanhu hushoma uye hwangotanga, uye tsvakurudzo zhinji yakaitirwa pazvipfuwo. Kusadya kunogona kuva njodzi kune vakuru, kunyanya kana vachidya mishonga yeshuga kana vachirasikirwa nehuremu husina kurongwa, uye hakurudziriwi kune vanhu vane dementia. Taurai nechiremba musati mashandura kudya kwenyu.

Hapana maakaundi kana zvekuzivisa. Tinoshandisa Google Analytics kuverenga kushanyira uye kuona mapeji anobatsira, uye webhurawuza yenyu inoyeuka kana mhamvu dzakapfava dzakavhurwa. Mifananidzo yamunosarudza yeMapaire Emifananidzo haizotumirwi kunze kwenyu. Tarisai chiziviso chezvakavanzika kuti muwane ruzivo rwakawanda.
Kwete. Golden Moments yekufara uye ruzivo rwakajairika chete. Mibvunzo yehutano itaurirwe nechiremba, uye kana paine tsaona shandisai 999.

faq.moreHtml: Ruzivo rwakawanda: kutamba pamwe chete, paanoti kuti kwete, zviitwa zvedementia yakasvika kumagumo uye dementia inogona kudzivirirwa here?

handout.seoTitle: Peji Rekuprinta: Mitambo Yakasununguka yeDementia Paintaneti
handout.description: Peji rimwe chete rekuprinta remhuri nevanochengeta, nezvemitambo yemifananidzo yakasununguka, yakapfava yevanhu vane dementia, yemapoka etsigiro nemapakeji ekuchengetera.
handout.lede: Printa peji iri kuboka retsigiro, mupakeji rekuchengetera kana pamusoro pefiriji. Shandisai murayiridzo wekuprinta wewebhurawuza yenyu; menyu nemabhatani zvinosiiwa pakuprinta.
handout.introHtml: Mifananidzo mikuru, mashoko akareruka uye pasina chinhu chekukundikana. Yakasununguka pafoni, tabuleti kana kombiyuta, pasina kunyoresa, pasina zvekuzivisa, pasina tayimer uye pasina mapoinzi. Garai pamwe chete muchishandurana.
handout.restHtml:
Mazano mashoma

  • Sarudzai nguva yezuva apo munhu ari pamunyanya wakanaka.
  • Tangai nekugadziriswa kuri nyore. Matailisi mana akakwana.
  • Taurai nezvemifananidzo. Kutaurirana kazhinji ndiko kwakanakisa.
  • Mirai apo zvichiri kunakidza. Kumira kare ndiko kubudirira kwakanaka.

Zvimwe pawebhusaiti

  • Mapeji ekuprinta zvakasununguka: tsvakirwa mashoko makuru, mapeji ekupenda, makadhi ekutaurirana uye bingo yemifananidzo.
  • Mazano ezviitwa kune nhanho yega yega, uye zvinyorwa nezvekutamba pamwe chete nezvekuzvichengeta.

Yekufara nenguva pamwe chete. Hazvisi mazano ezvokurapa, bvunzo kana kurapwa. Golden Moments inoburitswa neCloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Kune Mahofisi Ekuchengetera Vakuru, Raibhurari neMapoka Etsigiro
organizations.seoTitle: Mitambo Yemahara Yedementia Yemahofisi Ekutarira Vanhu nemapoka
organizations.description: Mazviiro ekurapira, mahofisi ekuvaraidza masikati, malaibrari, masangano ekuchembera nemapoka ekutsigira vanoshandisa sei mitambo yedu yemahara yedementia, pamwe nemeseji yekuwedzera zita redu parondedzero yezviripo.
organizations.lede: Zvese zviri pawebhusaiti iyi zvinogona kushandiswa mahara nevagari, nevanhu vemapoka nevatengi, pasina akaunti, rezinziro kana mari. Peji iri rinotsanangura zviripo uye kuti zvingagovaniswa sei.
organizations.shortText: {name}: mitambo yemifananidzo isina kumhanya uye zvikwereti zvemaitiro zvevanhu vanogara nedementia nevanovatarira. Hapana kunyoresa, hapana nguva, hapana mapoinzi.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) inopa mitambo {count} yemahara yepawebhusaiti yakagadzirirwa vanhu vanogara nedementia, kusanganisira mapeya emifananidzo nemifananidzo yakasara ichiratidzwa, puzzle iri nyore, kurongedza, mazwi akajairwa uye bingo yemifananidzo nemakadhi anodhindwa. Hapana akaunti, zvekushambadzira, nguva kana mapoinzi. Webhusaiti inewo zvikwereti zvemaitiro zvemumutauro wakajeka zvenhanho dzese dzedementia, zvakatorwa kubva kuNational Institute on Aging neAlzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: mitambo {count} yepawebhusaiti inoshanda pa laputopu, tablet kana TV yakabatanidzwa nekombiyuta. Hapana kuisa, akaunti kana kudhawunirodha. Ona mitambo yose.
organizations.printablesAfter: Shandisa batani rekudhinda paperu yega yega.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Mafomu emapoka: Bingo yemifananidzo ine makadhi anodhindwa uye mudanidzi ari pascreen, uye trivia iri nyore ine mibvunzo 50 ine sarudzo dzepfupiso uye mapoinzi ekutaura.
  • Zvikwereti zvemaitiro zvevashandi nemhuri, zvakarongwa nenhanho nemarudzi, zvakanyorwa mumutauro wakajeka nezvakatorwa. Tanga ne101 mazano emaitiro kana maitiro emapoka emagariro.
organizations.restHtml:
Mapoka anoshandisa sei

  • Mazviiro emagariro nekurarama nedementia: bingo yemifananidzo kana kupedza mazwi pa TV yepamba yekugara, nomunhu mumwe achidzvanya kuti aite boka rose.
  • Mahofisi ekuvaraidza masikati: chiteshi cha tablet chine Mapeya emifananidzo akaiswa kuva matairi mana, ekushandisa nemunhu mumwe nemumwe kwenguva pfupi.
  • Malaibrari emuzvikamu: mapepa etsvagiro yemazwi nemakadhi ekutaurirana mumapaketi ekurerutsa, uye webhusaiti yakachengetwa pamatablet emalaibrari.
  • Mapoka etsigiro yevanovatarira nemakafe ekurangarira: chinyorwa chimwe chinodhindwa chevhu rokupa mhuri kuti vatore kumba.
  • Zvipatara nevarongi vekuburitsa varwere: chinyorwa mumapaketi evanovatarira, kuti pave nechinhu chinonyaradza chekuita kumba kana pedivi rebhedi.

Zvatisingaiti

Mitambo iyi yekufara nekugara pamwe nenguva. Haiongorore, haiedze, haivhiri mapoinzi, hairapi kana kudzikisa dementia, uye tinokumbira masangano kuti arege kuirondedzera saizvozvo. Hapana zvekushambadzira, uye mitambo haibvunzi mazita, ruzivo rwehutano kana kuisa mifananidzo. Webhusaiti inoshandisa Google Analytics kuverenga kushanyira; chiziviso chedu chekuvanzika chinotsanangura zvinounganidzwa. Mifananidzo inoshandiswa muna Mapeya emifananidzo inogara mubrowser.

Isai isu parondedzero yenyu yezvinobatsira

Kana muine rondedzero yezvinhu zvevanovatarira, makapinda kubatanidza {domain}. Mungakopa tsananguro imwe neimwe.
organizations.linksHtml:
Mapeji akakodzera kubatanidza zvakananga: mitambo yemahara, zvinodhindwa zvemahara, maitiro eAlzheimer's uye kuti mutambe sei pamwe.

Mibvunzo kana kugadzirisa

Kana chimwe chiri pawebhusaiti chisina kunaka kana kusanzwisisika, kana zvinodiwa nemugari kana mutengi hazvizadziswi nezviripo, tiudzei pa {email}. Ndapota musatumira ruzivo rwemunhu kana rwehutano rwevagari kana vatengi.

app.title: Apu yaGolden Moments
app.description: Apu yemahara yaGolden Moments: kubatanidza mifananidzo kwakapfava nematairi mana makuru, mifananidzo yemhuri inochengetwa padivhaisi yenyu, mapakeji emifananidzo anoshanda pasina intaneti uye pasina akaunti.
app.lede: Zvese zvamunofarira pawebhusaiti, mune apu inoshanda pasina intaneti uye inogona kushandisa mifananidzo yemhuri yamunosarudza.
app.bodyHtml:
Tanga nezvidiki

Tanga nematile mana akakura nemifananidzo yakajairika. Chengetedza mifananidzo ichioneka, kana kuivanza kana zvichinzi zvakanaka. Modhi yakapfava haina nguva, mapoinzi kana chirango. Sarudza 4, 6, 8 kana 12 matile.

Iita zvako

Sarudza mifananidzo yemhuri nechisarudzo chemifananidzo chefoni yako. App inochengeta makopi madiki emifananidzo yezviitiko zvayo. Haishanduri raibhurari yako kana mifananidzo yoriginal, uye inochengeta mifananidzo inosvika 24 mubhoka imwe chete.

Ongororai pamwe chete

Ona mufananidzo mumwe panguva imwe. Mibvunzo yesarudzo inokurudzira hurukuro pasina kubvunza munhu kuti arangarire mazita kana kupa mhinduro yakanaka. Kungotarisa pamwe chete kwakwana.

Pasina intaneti pane zvakakosha

Mifananidzo yekutanga nemapakeji ese masere emifananidzo zvakasanganiswa neapp. Makopi emifananidzo yemhuri anoshanda pasina intaneti. Kusarudza mifananidzo inongova muiCloud kungada intaneti.

Pasina akaundi, pasina seva yekugovana mifananidzo

Makopi emifananidzo yemhuri anogara mu app pachishandiso. Unogona kubvisa makopi pasina kudzima mifananidzo yoriginal. Makopi ekuchengetedza emuchishandiso anogona kusanganisira data yeapp. Verenga mutemo wenyaya yeapp, uye rubatsiro rweapp rinotsanangura sitepisi imwe neimwe.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments ndeyekutamba nekugovana hurukuro. Haiiti dzidziso, kurapa, kudzivirira kana kuyera dementia kana Alzheimer’s.

gamesIndex.title: Mitambo Yakasununguka Yedementia & Alzheimer's Paintaneti
gamesIndex.description: Mitambo yakasununguka paintaneti yevakuru vanorarama nedementia kana Alzheimer's: kubatanidza mifananidzo, majigsaw akareruka, kuronga, nhetembo, kupenda, bingo. Hapana kunyoresa, nguva kana mapoinzi.
gamesIndex.lede: {count} mitambo yakasununguka yekutamba pamwe chete mu browser yako. Mifananidzo mikuru, mazwi akareruka, uye hapana chinokundikana: hapana nguva, hapana mapoinzi, hapana kunyoresa.
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Nhanho ndiyo girazi chete rakareruka. Tevererai zvinofadza munhu uye zvinonzwika zvakanaka nhasi.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Mamwe mafungiro kure nescreen: 101 zviitiko zvevanhu vane dementia, zviitiko nemitambo yeAlzheimer's, mitambo yakapfava yekurangarira uye mapuzzle.

faq.a: Mabatiro emifananidzo nematile mana ndiyo sarudzo yekutanga inotonhorera. Kana kusarudza pakati pemifananidzo kuchiita sekunge kwakanyanya, edzai Wana chimwe chakafanana nemifananidzo miviri. Kana muri boka, edzai bingo yemifananidzo.

faq.q: Mitambo inoshanda pa iPad kana foni?
faq.a: Ehe. Mutambo wose unoshanda mu browser pamafoni, matablet nekomputa, uye mifananidzo inokura kuti izadze screen. Tablet pachigadziro inowanzova yakanyanya kunyatsoita kuvanhu vaviri.

faq.q: Mitambo iyi yakakodzera kumunhu ane Alzheimer's here?
faq.a: Ehe. Yakagadzirirwa vanhu vanorarama nedementia, kusanganisira Alzheimer's, chikonzero chinonyanya kuwanikwa. Mifananidzo inoramba yakaonekwa, pane sarudzo shoma chete, uye hapana chinenguva kana mapoinzi, saka mitambo inobata pakuziva zvinhu zvakajairika kupfuura kurangarira zvitsva.

Idzo ndimitambo yekubatanidza nemifananidzo chete, inogona kufadza mukuru wese, asi yakagadzirwa kusaedza kurangarira: mu Mabatiro emifananidzo mifananidzo inoramba yakatarisa kumusoro kunyanya kana mukasarudza zvimwe. Gwaro redu rezvemitambo yekurangarira yevakuru ane dementia rinotsanangura kuti mutambo wowose wekurangarira unogona sei kuva wakapfava.

faq.q: Pane mitambo yeboka mudzimba dzekutarisirwa here?
faq.a: Ehe. Bingo yemifananidzo ine makadhi anodhindwa nomudanidzi pascreen, uye Pedzisa mazwi namakadhi ehurukuro zvinoshanda zvakanaka kana zvichiverengwa zvichinzi kuboka.

appFacts.summary: App yakasununguka yeiPhone, iPad neAndroid ine kubatanidza mifananidzo yakapfava pamatile kubva mana kusvika gumi nemaviri akakura, kubatanidza nekuongorora nemifananidzo yemhuri yaunosarudza, uye mapakeji emifananidzo masere akasanganiswa anoshanda pasina intaneti. Hapana akaundi, zvikwangwani, nguva kana mapoinzi.
features: Kubatanidza mifananidzo yakapfava nematile 4, 6, 8 kana 12 akakura; mifananidzo inoramba yakaonekwa kunyange kana usarudza kuivanza
Mifananidzo yemhuri yaunosarudza inokopiwa mu app kuti ibatanidzwe uye kuongororwa pamwe chete

Mapakeji masere emifananidzo akasanganiswa neapp; anoshanda pasina intaneti
Hapana akaundi, zvikwangwani, zvekutenga mu-app, nguva, mapoinzi kana chirango

faq.a: Ehe. Golden Moments (inonzi "{storeName}") yakasununguka paApp Store neGoogle Play. Inopa kubatanidza mifananidzo yakapfava nematile akakura, mitambo nemifananidzo yemhuri yaunosarudza, uye mapakeji emifananidzo anoshanda pasina intaneti.

faq.q: App ya Golden Moments yakasununguka here?
faq.a: Ehe. Inosunungurwa kudhawunirodha, pasina zvikwangwani, akaundi kana zvekutenga mu-app.

Ehe. Mifananidzo yekutanga nemapakeji ese masere emifananidzo zvakasanganiswa neapp, uye mifananidzo yemhuri inoshanda pasina intaneti kana yakatokopiwa mu app. Kusarudza mufananidzo unongochengetwa muiCloud kungada kubatana.

faq.q: Ndinogona here kushandisa mifananidzo yemhuri yedu?
faq.a: Ehe. Sarudzai mifananidzo nemusarudzi wemifananidzo wechishandiso chenyu. App inochengetedza makopi madiki emifananidzo pachishandiso ichishandisa mitambo yayo, haitumire mifananidzo kwayo, uye haishandure mifananidzo yakatanga. Unogona kubvisa makopi iwayo nguva dzese.

faq.q: Ndiro rekudzidzisa ndangariro kana rekuedza ndangariro here?
faq.a: Kwete. Golden Moments yekunakidzwa uye nguva yekuva pamwe chete. Haina mapoinzi kana bvunzo, uye haiongorori, haisi kurapa, kudzivirira kana kuyera dementia kana chirwere cheAlzheimer's.

gameFaqYes.q: Pane vhezheni yeapp yemutambo uyu here?
gameFaqYes.a: Ehe. Iyo app yemahara ye Golden Moments yeiPhone, iPad neAndroid ine mutambo wakapfava wekubatanidza mifananidzo, inogona kushandisa mifananidzo yemhuri yamunosarudza, uye inoshanda pasina intaneti. Hapana akaunti, zvizivisa kana mapoinzi.

gameFaqNo.a: Kwete mutambo uyu chaiwo. Mutambo uyu unoramba wakasununguka pano pachishandiso chako chewebhu.
